'''Gestron''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Tennuutta sector/Legends|Tennuutta sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==History==
Gestron was the site of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base that was [[Raid on Gestron|raided]] by [[Garm Bel Iblis's movement|forces]] under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="DFRSb" />
